_what: Post-split cost snapshot for the gateway kernel/reference split (FAFF-607, PR #819). Companion to pre-split-snapshot-20260901.json. Prices the SAME pinned reference run per-lane: each transcript is classified by its running skill and repriced against that skill's post-split resident gateway prefix (kernel + only the lane references it Reads), then summed.
source_run: evidence/cost-run-20260829-100405 (full L4 lights-out build, 843 calls) — the same run the pre-split baseline was captured on
method: Per-file: classify each of the 19 transcripts (4 top-level + 15 subagents) by its skill from the opening instruction, assign that skill's measured post-split prefix, and run `node eval/tokenomics.mjs --transcript <file> --fixed 66165 --lean <skill prefix>` per file. Reconstructed baseline sums to $132.90, reconciling with the pinned whole-run $132.91 (validates the classification).

per_lane_prefixes._note: measured post-split resident gateway prefix per skill = kernel (28634) + the lane references that skill Reads

per_lane_cost.note: heavy-blend prefix; prep/graft/tidy not individually separable in these four, all heavy consumers 52-61k
biggest saver: light lane (kernel + methodology) sheds ~29k per call
gateway is not a cost driver here (code-blind, little gateway resident)
these tasks never load the faff gateway

brackets_for_context._note: whole-run uniform --lean bounds, for comparison with the per-lane blend above

findings: On this build-dominated L4 run the split saves ~$4.61 (-3.5%), near the bottom of the [-1.6%, -12.3%] bracket.
The spec_review producer subagents are the single biggest saver ($2.00 of $4.61) despite small raw cost, because they are a light lane (kernel + methodology ~37k) that sheds ~29k per call.

The heavy consumers that dominate the bill (graft executors ~61k, beep-boop ~60k) shed only ~5k and barely move; the evaluator and bootstrap tasks save nothing (gateway not resident / not a cost driver).

The dollar prize on build-dominated runs needs FAFF-970's kernel-leaning (which lifts every lane, including the heavy ones) plus read-heavy interactive workloads that this build transcript does not represent.
caveats: Holds under the pre-split baseline's own assumption that the full 66,165-tok gateway was resident on every faff-skill call.

The four autonomous prep/graft/tidy subagents were priced at a heavy blend (~57k) because prep/graft/tidy could not be cleanly separated among them; all are heavy consumers (52-61k), so the uncertainty is at most ~+/-$0.3.
spec_review priced as faffter-dark-spec-review (kernel + methodology). If an occupant additionally Read autonomous.md its prefix would be ~45k and its saving smaller.
Cost is real; the tps-based time legs from the pre-split snapshot are not recomputed here.
repro: For a single uniform figure: node eval/tokenomics.mjs --transcript evidence/cost-run-20260829-100405/transcripts --fixed 66165 --lean <prefix>. For the per-lane blend: reprice each transcript under transcripts/ (+ transcripts/subagents/) with its skill's prefix from per_lane_prefixes and sum.
related: FAFF-607 (the split), FAFF-970 (kernel-leaning follow-up), FAFF-932 (tokenomics harness), FAFF-963 (declared-manifest matrix)
